title: Trusted External Reconstruction and True Process-Boundary Restart Qualification
scope: committed-boundary process restart through an adapter-owned external representation
problem: F-KT12 qualifies opaque typed export and restore only while a live kernel_persistence_snapshot_t still exists. After total process loss there is no qualified path from an external representation back to an opaque typed snapshot without exposing independent revision or lineage mutation.

kernel_role: remain free of files, paths, parsers and byte formats
retain F-KT12 schema/layout validation and restore semantics
provide one atomic trusted reconstruction seam for a complete provenance record plus one already-decoded physical continuation state
validate the entire imported record before publishing a ready typed persistence carrier
adapter_role: decode physical state before calling the trusted kernel seam
call the trusted reconstruction seam atomically rather than setting lineage, revision or time independently
ordinary_runtime_api: no raw overwrite of an initialized committed state

trusted_reconstruction_record.atomicity: all fields are accepted or rejected as one record; no field is independently assignable through the ordinary API
validation: unbound time uses the canonical zero payload
decoded physical state allocated and cloneable
constructed typed carrier passes the existing F-KT12 ready checks

qualification_adapter.status: test-only concrete adapter used to qualify the generic boundary
qualification_adapter.representation: strict versioned line-oriented artifact with real values stored by exact int64 bit pattern
qualification_adapter.codec_registry: one known deterministic F-KT physical-state codec plus explicit unknown-codec rejection

process_boundary_test.producer: separate executable T0->T1, export typed state, adapter writes artifact, process exits
process_boundary_test.consumer: new executable parses artifact, decodes physical state, reconstructs opaque typed carrier, restores committed state, continues T1->T2

negative_gates: duplicate or unexpected provenance field fails closed
restore into already initialized target remains rejected by F-KT12

architecture_invariants.9_generic_time: committed scalar time preserved without calendar assumptions
architecture_invariants.16_multiswap_primary: per-column logical record; batching may be layered later
architecture_invariants.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: neither persisted forcing nor solver policy mutation
architecture_invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: restart path must remain diagnosable without persisting reporting history
architecture_invariants.28_runtime_coupler_composition: artifact and codec ownership stay outside kernel

explicit_nonclaims: no blanket compatibility across schema or layout changes
